title: Write 4 case study narratives demonstrating '3x faster cohort coordination' for African bootcamps
description:
Write 4 realistic, evidence-grounded case study narratives (300-400 words each) illustrating how African bootcamp managers achieve '3x faster cohort coordination' by switching from fragmented apps (Slack/WhatsApp/Zoom/Drive) to Zedu.

Each narrative must feature:
1. Cohort Profile: Type of bootcamp (e.g. software engineering, data science, product design in Lagos or Nairobi).
2. The Coordination Bottleneck: Time lost juggling Zoom links, lost assignments in WhatsApp chats, and answering repetitive onboarding questions.
3. The Zedu Solution: How structured cohort channels, built-in live classes, and AI study assistants cut coordination time.
4. Outcome: Concrete coordination improvements citing flat Naira pricing with no per-student penalty.

Deliver ready-to-publish markdown in attachment adhering strictly to verified features on zedu.chat.
rationale: Directly supports our bootcamp acquisition focus and validates our core proof point ('3x faster cohort coordination') for cost-conscious African educators.
